Our complete services minimize logistic planning, making intermodal freight and cargo handling seamless, efficient and cost effective. Interested in working for us? Careers What We Offer Our SERVICES Transportation Services R&A Trucking is a full-service trucking company. With our company fleet and network of asset based and partnered carriers, we are ready to service all of your commercial trucking needs. Drayage Services R&A Trucking specializes in container drayage service for the Ports of Oakland, Richmond, San Francisco and Stockton as well intermodal service at the Oakland and Lathrop UP rail ramp & Oakland BNSF rail ramp to any United States destination. Logistics SF Bay Area logistic services. R&A boasts past and recent experience in logistical support and movement across all of the distribution network channels. Warehousing and Distribution R&A Trucking offers complete warehousing and distribution services. We support the industry with transload and JIT distribution. Whatever your need, from large metal coils to the smallest palletized accessories, R&A has the equipment and experience to do the job right. Container Lifting We pickup and deliver your storage container wherever and whenever you need it. These are mobile, self loading container trailer trucks known as Side-loaders. R&A also provides nationwide coverage through our network of partnered asset based carriers to move freight to or from any destination in North America. \n Although once referred to as “The Beyonce of Agile Marketing,” Andrea does spend time away from her kanban board occasionally. Her favorite pastimes are camping, skiing, and hiking in her adopted Colorado home, ideally followed by a local microbrew and a British mystery novel.

What personal data we collect and why we collect it

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Contact forms

If you submit a form via our website, we collect and store that information in order to contact you. Some forms may have an option to add you to a list that we will use to periodically email you. If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

We collect anonymous analytics data via Google Analytics. We use this data to optimize our website performance and content. This analytics data cannot be used to personally identify you.

Who we share your data with

We do not share your data with any third party organizations or companies.

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

Northern Colorado's Best CPA

Grey CPAs is here with you every step of the way on your path to success. Serving Northern Colorado small businesses.

 
 
 
 
The team at Grey CPAs have been tirelessly helping businesses in the Northern Colorado area including Windsor, Fort Collins, Loveland, Greeley, Longmont, Berthoud and beyond with accounting services.
The Windsor CO based CPA is dedicated to helping Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor and Greeley businesses and families create and maintain sustainable wealth, as well as putting client service and communication at the top of the priority list.
 
Helping businesses to create stability regarding all things financial as well as maintain tax compliance and profitability, Grey CPAs is a company that looks to the future of those they work with.
 
Billionaire and financial expert Warren Buffett once said, “I don’t look to jump over 7-foot bars — I look for 1-foot bars that I can step over.” This step-by-step approach has made Warren a success by simplifying things others find to be complex.
 
You don’t need to be a billionaire to enjoy sustainable wealth now and into the future, what you need is someone on your side who is an expert at handling all things financial.
 
Grey CPAs is here to be with you every step of the way on your path to success, and we believe it to be a privilege to earn your trust. We look forward to partnering with you, contact us today!

Contact us for a FREE Consultation

Small Business Tax Compliance
Get the most value out of your business. We understand the importance of well organized tax accounting. We get the most out of it and keep following all the changes in the law all year long.

Small Business Tax Planning
Focus on your business first. As a business owner, you may consider the word “tax” as a four letter word and shudder at the idea of tax planning. We offer comprehensive tax planning for businesses of all sizes.

We believe accounting should feel personal, not transactional. From tax prep to advisory, we’re a full-service firm that simplifies the complex and puts people first. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just launching your accounting career, you’ll find a collaborative environment, real growth opportunities, and a team that treats tax season like a team sport. 
Our clients count on us for more than numbers—they rely on us for clarity, guidance, and consistent support. And we deliver, fueled by open communication, sharp thinking, and yes, plenty of coffee. 
If you’re passionate about helping people navigate their financial world—and want to do it with a crew that’s as driven as they are down-to-earth—you might just belong here.
Keep scrolling to peruse current openings.

 Join a team that’s redefining tax season – one client at a time

Tax Manager Process Improvement & Team Development

At Grey CPAs, we believe exceptional client service starts with exceptional people. We are a relationship-driven public accounting firm committed to helping our clients navigate complex tax matters while building lasting partnerships based on trust, responsiveness, and expertise. We are seeking an experienced Tax Manager who is passionate about serving clients, developing team members, improving processes, and helping shape the future of our growing firm.
Position Overview:
Manage tax engagements from planning through filing and delivery.
Review complex tax returns and provide tax planning and consulting services.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients and a mentor to team members.
Help develop and refine workflows, processes, and systems that support firm growth and efficiency.
Partner with firm leadership to improve operations, client experience, and team performance.
Workflow Management & Process Optimization
Evaluate and improve tax workflow processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and accountability.
Develop standardized procedures, documentation, and best practices.
Create scalable systems that support continued growth and operational excellence.
Identify workflow bottlenecks and implement practical solutions.
Improve turnaround times, capacity planning, and project management.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives.
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
7+ years of public accounting tax experience.
Strong knowledge of federal and state tax regulations.
Experience reviewing tax returns and managing client engagements.
Demonstrated experience managing tax workflows and engagement pipelines.
Experience improving processes, systems, and operational efficiency.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
Active CPA license or Enrolled Agent (EA) designation.
Leadership, supervisory, or mentoring experience.
Tax planning and advisory experience.
Experience helping a growing firm develop procedures and operational best practices.
Schedule & Hours:
Tax Season: Full-time, 50= hours per week
Off-Season: Reduced schedule based on workload.
Experience helping a growing firm develop procedures and operational best practices.
This position offers a long-term opportunity with a growing firm for the right candidate.
 
Compensation:
Compensation is dependent upon experience, credentials, technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and demonstrated success in workflow management and process improvement.
Non-Licensed Tax Manager: $90,000 – $120,000 annually.
Licensed CPA or EA Tax Manager: $115,000 – $145,000 annually.
Additional compensation opportunities may be available based on performance, leadership contributions, and firm growth initiatives.
Why Join Grey CPAs?
Be part of a supportive, professional, and growing firm
Flexible scheduling during non-peak seasons.
Professional development and continuing education support.
Collaborative, supportive, and team-focused culture.
Meaningful opportunity to help build the future of the firm.
 

 How to Apply

Submit your resume and cover letter to brooke@greycpas.com. 
In your cover letter, please tell us a bit about yourself and why you believe you’d be a great addition to the Grey CPAs team. We’re excited to learn what makes you you —and how your skills, perspective, and energy can help us continue delivering exceptional service to our clients.

Jeremy Rosenthal

Founder of Rosenthal Injury Law

Attorney Jeremy Rosenthal is dedicated to helping his clients seek just compensation for their injuries regardless of the lengths he has to go to or the distances he may have to travel in order to get it. His determination to aggressively advocate for his clients is exemplified by a case where his client suffered burns from a defective BBQ grill made in China. To secure a deposition from the CEO, Jeremy flew halfway around the world to meet with him. The case settled within a month of his return home.

Many personal injury cases involve insurance companies, and Jeremy is well suited to taking these big corporations on as he has inside knowledge of their tactics and strategies. Before he started fighting for plaintiff’s rights, he worked for insurance companies doing insurance defense work. Jeremy now uses the knowledge he gained in that position to help his clients seek just compensation for their injuries. In addition, just after graduating from law school, Jeremy spent time clerking for a Judge in Colorado. Having worked as a law clerk, an insurance defense attorney, and a plaintiff’s trial lawyer has helped Jeremy gain invaluable experience in all sides of the legal process. This level of expertise helps get the vast majority of cases favorably settled without having to go to trial. If negotiations are not successful, you can rest assured that Attorney Rosenthal is ready for trial.

Jeremy has over two decades of experience working as a personal injury attorney in Denver, Colorado. His firm exclusively works with personal injury cases and other trial-related matters. Over his many years in practice, he has represented clients with a wide variety of claims, including slip and falls, car accidents , product liability, and dog bites .

When Jeremy is not running his practice and seeking justice for his clients, he is an avid outdoor enthusiast. Jeremy enjoys spending time canoeing and hiking through Colorado’s beautiful wilderness. In addition to these activities, he enjoys playing in Texas Hold’em poker tournaments. Jeremy also donates his time and money to rescue organizations that help big cats, including lions, tigers, leopards, and other exotic cats.
